summary: Prove catalan_G_numerical_bounds : G > 0.915 ∧ G < 0.916 (currently axiom with [lewin1981] ref)
comment: BorromeanVolumeCatalan.lean line ~140 has `axiom catalan_G_numerical_bounds : catalan_G > (0.915:ℝ) ∧ catalan_G < (0.916:ℝ)` (set during 2026-06-03 session a7f80972 batch). Proof strategy: alternating series Leibniz bound. For G = Σ (-1)^k/(2k+1)² with N=22, |G - S_22| ≤ 1/(2·23+1)² = 1/2209, S_22 ≈ 0.91594, so G ∈ (0.91549, 0.91639) ⊆ (0.915, 0.916). Needs Mathlib's alternating-series bound lemma (likely `Antitone.cauchySeq_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero` or similar — verify with lean_loogle when lake env available). Not attempted in 2026-06-03 session because remote env has no `lake` binary and `lean_leansearch` SSL-blocked, so Mathlib API names couldn't be verified before push.

data.proof_sketch: 1. Show series is alternating with antitone |terms| via `Antitone.cauchySeq_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero`. 2. Use Leibniz error bound |G - S_N| ≤ a_{N+1}. 3. At N=22, compute S_22 as rational + norm_num. 4. linarith with 1/2209 envelope.
data.blocker: needs working `lake` + `lean-lsp` to verify Mathlib alternating-series API names

summary: Extend QSchurYLambdaClosedForm Lean from H_2 to H_3 (5 partitions of n=3 missing)
comment: QSchurYLambdaClosedForm.lean currently has qSchur_H2_top, qSchur_H2_bottom, qSchur_H2_normalization (discharged). H_3 needs the analogous theorems for partitions (3), (2,1), (1,1,1). Mechanical mirror of H_2 pattern; uses contentSum, qBracket, qFactorial unfoldings + decide + field_simp + ring. STALE — see resolution_note.

data.proof_sketch: for each λ: unfold ySchurClosedForm; have hc : contentSum λ = <C>; have hs : λ.sum = 3; rw [hc, hs]; show qFactorial 3 q = [3]_q!; field_simp + ring
data.resolution_note: Already implemented in main: qSchur_H3_top (line 262), qSchur_H3_mid (line 273), qSchur_H3_bottom (line 284) — all proved via the H_2 pattern with helper lemmas q_add_inv_ne_zero and q_sq_add_one_add_inv_sq_ne_zero. Commit af3316bf ('lean(QSchurYLambdaClosedForm): refresh docstrings — H_2 + H_3 are sorry-free') landed before this 2026-05-31 todo was created. No clean H_3 'normalization' theorem (un-weighted partition sum is not 1 at H_3 without dim_q(λ)² weighting). Flagged stale 2026-06-03 post-#1736 merge cleanup. Owner action: close as resolved (per CLAUDE.md TodoItem lifecycle rules, only humans may close todos; agents may not set status to 'resolved' or remove entries).

summary: Discharge 2 sorries in MathlibExt/SDPRankEquality.lean (R1 + R2 factoring)
comment: Per file docstring: 'helium3_uniqueness_closed is an axiom (zero sorry); kernel-disjoint + affine-Slater inputs have proven sub-instances; chain is fully sorry-free'. But the file has 2 sorries per grep. Likely the R1 (range containment) or R2 (strict-complementarity rank equality) lemmas. Both follow textbook Alizadeh-Haeberly-Overton 1997 §3 + Boyd-Vandenberghe §5.5.4. PSD properties from Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef.

data.proof_sketch: R1: rank-nullity from S * Φ = 0; PSD assumption gives kernel containment. R2: strict-complementarity ⟹ ker(S) ∩ ker(Φ) = {0} ⟹ rank equality via dimension counting.
